post.title: Americans' job fears just hit their highest since 2020
post.ig:
Americans' job fears just hit their highest level since April 2020.
The New York Fed's October survey (released Nov 9, 2026) puts the odds that unemployment rises in a year at 45.3%, up 1.4 points.
Twist: the odds of finding a new job after a layoff rose to 46.5%, the highest since November 2025.
The expected chance of missing a minimum debt payment rose to 13.8%; expected rent growth is 7.7%.
Sources: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Survey of Consumer Expectations, Reuters, ABA Banking Journal.
